arxiv-1808-06878.title: Solar radio emission as a disturbance of aeronautical radionavigation
arxiv-1808-06878.creator: Christophe Marqué, Karl-Ludwig Klein, Christian Monstein, Hermann Opgenoorth, Antti Pulkkinen, Stephan Buchert, Säm Krucker, Rudiger Van Hoof, Peter Thulesen
arxiv-1808-06878.description: A 2018 arXiv research paper by Christophe Marqué, Karl-Ludwig Klein, Christian Monstein, Hermann Opgenoorth, Antti Pulkkinen, Stephan Buchert, Säm Krucker, Rudiger Van Hoof, Peter Thulesen. On November 4th 2015 secondary air traffic control radar was strongly disturbed in Sweden and some other European countries. The disturbances occurred when the radar antennas were pointing at the Sun.

arxiv-2102-00694.title: On profinite polyadic groups Thanks: MSC(2010): 20N15 Keywords: Polyadic groups; n n -ary groups; Profinite groups and polyadic groups; Post’s cover and retract of a polyadic group
arxiv-2102-00694.creator: M. Shahryari, M. Rostami
arxiv-2102-00694.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by M. Shahryari, M. Rostami. We study the structure of profinite polyadic groups and we prove that a polyadic topological group ( G , f ) (G,f) is profinite, if and only if, it is compact, Hausdorff, totally disconnected.

arxiv-2111-14471.title: Spinor Representation of the Hamiltonian Constraint in 3D LQG with a Non-zero Cosmological Constant
arxiv-2111-14471.creator: Valentin Bonzom, Maïté Dupuis, Qiaoyin Pan
arxiv-2111-14471.description: Abstract We develop in a companion paper the kinematics of three-dimensional loop quantum gravity in Euclidean signature and with a negative cosmological constant, focusing in particular on the spinorial representation which is well-known at zero cosmological constant. In this paper, we put this formalism to the test by quantizing the Hamiltonian constraint on the dual of a triangulation.

arxiv-2202-13947.title: Data-Augmentation for Graph Neural Network Learning of the Relaxed Energies of Unrelaxed Structures
arxiv-2202-13947.creator: Jason B. Gibson, Ajinkya C. Hire, Richard G. Hennig
arxiv-2202-13947.description: Abstract Computational materials discovery has continually grown in utility over the past decade due to advances in computing power and crystal structure prediction algorithms (CSPA). However, the computational cost of the ab initio calculations required by CSPA limits its utility to small unit cells, reducing the compositional and structural space the algorithms can explore.

arxiv-2210-05178.title: Pre-Training for Robots: Offline RL Enables Learning New Tasks in a Handful of Trials
arxiv-2210-05178.creator: Aviral Kumar, Anikait Singh, Frederik Ebert, Mitsuhiko Nakamoto, Yanlai Yang, Chelsea Finn, Sergey Levine
arxiv-2210-05178.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Aviral Kumar, Anikait Singh, Frederik Ebert, Mitsuhiko Nakamoto, Yanlai Yang, Chelsea Finn, Sergey Levine. Progress in deep learning highlights the tremendous potential of utilizing diverse robotic datasets for attaining effective generalization and makes it enticing to consider leveraging broad datasets for attaining robust generalization in robotic learning as well. However, in practice, we often want to learn a new skill in a new environment that is unlikely to be contained in the prior data.

arxiv-2305-05843.title: MoCA: M em o ry- C entric, A daptive Execution for Multi-Tenant Deep Neural Networks
arxiv-2305-05843.creator: Seah Kim, Hasan Genc, Vadim Vadimovich Nikiforov, Krste Asanović, Borivoje Nikolić, Yakun Sophia Shao
arxiv-2305-05843.description: Abstract Driven by the wide adoption of deep neural networks (DNNs) across different application domains, multi-tenancy execution, where multiple DNNs are deployed simultaneously on the same hardware, has been proposed to satisfy the latency requirements of different applications while improving the overall system utilization.

arxiv-2310-18937.title: The Utility of “Even if…” Semifactual Explanation to Optimise Positive Outcomes Thanks: This is a preprint, please cite the conference version at NeurIPS 2023.
arxiv-2310-18937.creator: Eoin M. Kenny, Weipeng Huang
arxiv-2310-18937.description: Abstract When users receive either a positive or negative outcome from an automated system, Explainable AI (XAI) has almost exclusively focused on how to mutate negative outcomes into positive ones by crossing a decision boundary using counterfactuals (e.g., “If you earn 2k more, we will accept your loan application” ).

arxiv-2311-09750.title: Emiliano Tolotti
arxiv-2311-09750.description: Abstract In the current era, known as Noisy Intermediate-Scale Quantum (NISQ), encoding large amounts of data in the quantum devices is challenging and the impact of noise significantly affects the quality of the obtained results. A viable approach for the execution of quantum classification algorithms is the introduction of a well-known machine learning paradigm, namely, the ensemble methods.

arxiv-2402-10694.title: Exact dg categories I: foundations
arxiv-2402-10694.creator: Xiaofa Chen
arxiv-2402-10694.description: Abstract . We introduce the notion of exact dg category, which provides a differential graded enhancement of Nakaoka–Palu’s notion of extriangulated category. We give a definition in complete analogy with Quillen’s but where the category of kernel-cokernel pairs is replaced with a more sophisticated homotopy category.

arxiv-2406-13538.creator: Guibin Liu 1,2 , Xuhong Ma 1,2 , Kang Zhou 1,4 , Binbin Liu 1,2 , Lulu Zheng 1,2 , Xianglong Bi 1,2 , Shumin Wu 1,2 , Yanming Lu 1,2 , Ziping Li 1 , Wenjian Wan 1 , Zhenzhen Zhang 1 , Junsong Peng 3 ,Ya Zhang 5, Heping Zeng 3,4,∗, Hua Li 1,2,

Frequency combs show various applications in molecular fingerprinting, imaging, communications, and so on.

arxiv-2408-11255.title: MEV Capture and Decentralization in Execution Tickets
arxiv-2408-11255.creator: Jonah Burian, Davide Crapis, Fahad Saleh
arxiv-2408-11255.description: Abstract We provide an economic model of Execution Tickets and use it to study the ability of the Ethereum protocol to capture MEV from block construction. We demonstrate that Execution Tickets extract all MEV when all buyers are homogeneous, risk neutral and face no capital costs. We also show that MEV capture decreases with risk aversion and capital costs.

arxiv-2511-21967.title: Lindblad Quantum Dynamics as Euler–Poincaré Reduction on Adjoint–Coupled Semidirect Products
arxiv-2511-21967.creator: Leonardo J. Colombo
arxiv-2511-21967.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Leonardo J. Colombo. We present a geometric and variational derivation of the Gorini–Kossakowski–Sudarshan–Lindblad (GKSL) equation based on a Lie–theoretic construction that we call the adjoint–coupled semidirect product (ACSP). An ACSP consists of a Lie group G G acting on a representation space V V through (possibly several copies of) the adjoint action, together with a second, adjointly compatible action whose failure to commute defines an adjoint torsion K ⁡ ( ξ , v ) = ξ ⋅ v − v ⋅ ξ K(\xi,v)=\xi\cdot v-v\cdot\xi

arxiv-2601-04694.title: ResMAS: Resilience Optimization in LLM-based Multi-agent Systems
arxiv-2601-04694.creator: Zhilun Zhou, Zihan Liu, Jiahe Liu, Qingyu Shao, Yihan Wang, Kun Shao, Depeng Jin, Fengli Xu
arxiv-2601-04694.description: Abstract Large Language Model-based Multi-Agent Systems (LLM-based MAS), where multiple LLM agents collaborate to solve complex tasks, have shown impressive performance in many areas. However, MAS are typically distributed across different devices or environments, making them vulnerable to perturbations such as agent failures.

arxiv-2601-16675.title: I Guess That’s Why They Call it the Blues: Causal Analysis for Audio Classifiers
arxiv-2601-16675.creator: David A. Kelly, Hana Chockler
arxiv-2601-16675.description: Abstract It is well-known that audio classifiers often rely on non-musically relevant features and spurious correlations to classify audio. Hence audio classifiers are easy to manipulate or confuse, resulting in wrong classifications. While inducing a misclassification is not hard, until now the set of features that the classifiers rely on was not well understood.

britannica-1911-lipsius-richard-adelbert.creator: Encyclopaedia Britannica
britannica-1911-lipsius-richard-adelbert.description: Article 'Lipsius, Richard Adelbert' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 16), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. His other works include Die Pilatusakten (1871, new ed., 1886), Dogmatische Beiträge (1878), Die Quellen der ältesten Ketzergeschichte (1875), Die apokryphen Apostelgeschichten (1883–1890), Hauptpunkte der christl. Glaubenslehre im Umriss dargestellt (1889), and commentaries on the Epistles to the Galatians, Romans and Philippians in H. Holtzmann’s Handkommentar zum Neuen Testament (1891–1892).

plos-pone-0001544.description: PLOS ONE research article. The supply of transfusable red blood cells (RBCs) is not sufficient in many countries. If erythroid cell lines able to produce transfusable RBCs in vitro were established, they would be valuable resources. However, such cell lines have not been established. To evaluate the feasib

pmc-10624899.title: Spliceosome component Usp39 contributes to hepatic lipid homeostasis through the regulation of autophagy
pmc-10624899.creator: Donghai Cui, Zixiang Wang, Qianli Dang, Jing Wang, Junchao Qin, Jianping Song, Xiangyu Zhai, Yachao Zhou, Ling Zhao, Gang Lu, Hongbin Liu, Gang Liu, Runping Liu, Changshun Shao, Xiyu Zhang, Zhaojian Liu
pmc-10624899.description: Regulation of alternative splicing (AS) enables a single transcript to yield multiple isoforms that increase transcriptome and proteome diversity. Here, we report that spliceosome component Usp39 plays a role in the regulation of hepatocyte lipid homeostasis. We demonstrate that Usp39 expression is downregulated in hepatic tissues of non-alcoholic fatty liver disease (NAFLD) and non-alcoholic steatohepatitis (NASH) subjects.

pmc-10722937.title: Validation, performance, and reliability of two automated tests for vitamin B12 and folate assay
pmc-10722937.creator: Simone Bianciardi, Giulia Tesi, Helena Cerutti, Alessandra Cartocci, Roberto Guerranti, Caterina Silvestrini, Sabrina Gori, Tommaso Bandini, Alessandra Brogi, Roberto Leoncini
pmc-10722937.description: Background:Deficiency of Vitamin B12 and folate may determine hematological, neurological, and metabolic alterations; therefore, an accurate quantification of their serum levels is required, especially in the presence of symptoms that might suggest a deficiency. CHORUS VIT B12 and CHORUS FOLATE are two automated immunoassays, developed to quantify vitamin B12 and folate, respectively, in human serum.

pmc-11659883.title: De novo sequencing allows genome-wide identification of genes involved in galactomannan synthesis in locust bean (Ceratonia siliqua)
pmc-11659883.creator: Mitsuaki Akutsu, Akihisa Shinozawa, Tomoaki Nishiyama, Yoichi Sakata, Yuji Hiwatashi
pmc-11659883.description: Locust bean (Ceratonia siliqua) accumulates the galactomannan (GM) locust bean gum (LBG) in its seeds. LBG is a major industrial raw material used as a food thickener and gelling agent, whose unique properties mean that it cannot be readily replaced by other GMs.

pmc-12557959.title: Diagnostic performance of ELISA kits and expanded antigen panels for hemagglutination inhibition assays in pig herds enzootically infected with porcine Influenza A viruses
pmc-12557959.creator: J Stadler, K Grau, K Lillie-Jaschniski, S Pesch, A Graaf-Rau, T Harder, S Zoels, R Fux, M Ritzmann, M Eddicks
pmc-12557959.description: BackgroundA combined approach using both indirect and direct detection methods can improve the diagnostic efficiency of swine Influenza A virus (swIAV) infections. Despite its importance, limited research has been conducted on the diagnostic performance of serological tests commonly used for routine swIAV surveillance.

pmc-12876816.title: Are open-access fees undermining science as a public good?
pmc-12876816.creator: Lucindo Quintans-Júnior, Jodnes Sobreira Vieira, Paulo Ricardo Martins-Filho
pmc-12876816.description: Cs) - support research, yet its dissemination often depends on journals demanding unaffordable open-access fees. Scientific dedication is thereby transformed into revenue streams for a few publishers in high-income nations, a concern raised more than a decade ago (Van Noorden, 2013[5]).

pmc-13221011.title: Fully synthetic replication of complex real biological cell clusters using a novel cluster-based ‘Rosetta-Routine’ computational modelling process
pmc-13221011.creator: Bradley Mason, Laura Justham, Liam Whitby, Alison Whitby, Stuart Scott, Samuel Nti, Jon Petzing
pmc-13221011.description: Flow cytometry (FC) is essential for the precise quantification and characterisation of individual cell populations in a larger heterogenous cell suspension. FC analysis provides a foundation for advanced clinical diagnostics and is a key component in many life-saving therapeutic strategies across a broad range of medical conditions.

pmc-13259096.title: Herbal Neurotherapeutics for Cognitive Disorders: Integrative Mechanisms Linking Neurotransmitter Systems, Neurodegeneration, and the Gut-Brain Axis
pmc-13259096.creator: Muntajin Rahman, Khadija Akter, Amama Rani, Moon Nyeo Park, Bonglee Kim
pmc-13259096.description: Cognitive disorders, including Alzheimer’s disease, Parkinson’s disease, schizophrenia, depression, and vascular dementia, are associated with dysregulation of neurotransmitter systems, including acetylcholine, dopamine, serotonin, glutamate, and γ-aminobutyric acid (GABA). These disorders are increasingly recognized as multifactorial conditions involving oxidative stress, neuroinflammation, mitochondrial dysfunction, synaptic impairment, blood–brain barrier disruption, metabolic imbalance, and gut–brain axis dysregulation.

pmc-13312616.title: The value of the serum cytokine-to-immune ratio model in predicting the progression-free survival after interventional therapy for hepatocellular carcinoma
pmc-13312616.creator: Jun Zhou, Bo Zhang, Jing Niu
pmc-13312616.description: ObjectiveTo develop and validate a prognostic nomogram for predicting progression-free survival (PFS) in patients with hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) following transcatheter arterial chemoembolization (TACE) combined with radiofrequency ablation (RFA). The model incorporates serum transforming growth factor-β1 (TGF-β1), interleukin-8 (IL-8), and the peripheral blood CD4+/CD8 + ratio to enable precise risk stratification and inform adjuvant therapy decisions.

pmc-13517406.title: Identification of Partitivirus-like RdRPs in the Brevipalpus yothersi Genome Supports Viral-to-Arthropod Horizontal Gene Transfer
pmc-13517406.creator: Bruno Afonso Corrêa, Thaís Medinilha Pancher, Denis Calandriello Calio, Aline Daniele Tassi, Laura Rossetto Pereira, Daniel Carrillo, Ricardo Harakava, Valdenice Moreira Novelli, Elliot Watanabe Kitajima, Pedro Luis Ramos-González, Juliana Freitas-Astúa, Daniel Gonzalez-Ibeas
pmc-13517406.description: RNA-dependent RNA polymerases (RdRPs) are essential enzymes involved in RNA virus replication and eukaryotic RNA silencing. They are generally absent in vertebrates but present in some invertebrate lineages, such as nematodes and certain arthropods. Brevipalpus yothersi is a phytophagous mite of agricultural relevance due to its role as a vector of plant-infecting viruses.

pmc-13557796.title: Organ-specific modulation of antioxidant functions by combined voluntary exercise and radon inhalation in mice
pmc-13557796.creator: Reiju Takenaka, Ayumi Tanaka, Shogo Miyanaga, Shota Naoe, Shuna Goto, Mitsuki Nagano, Kotaro Tano, Norie Kanzaki, Akihiro Sakoda, Kiyonori Yamaoka, Takahiro Kataoka
pmc-13557796.description: Radon inhalation as well as voluntary exercise increase antioxidant function in experimental animals. However, the combined effects of radon inhalation and exercise on antioxidant functions have not yet been investigated. In this study, we examined the effects of combined voluntary wheel running (VWR) and radon inhalation on antioxidant functions in various organs of mice.
